latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Maker Free HD 1.0.0 — First release

- Instantly create and export HD videos from images and clips with automatic AI editing, no software required.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG files up to 500MB.
- Generates a 30-second 1080p MP4 promo video with background music in 1–2 minutes.
- No user registration required: free token and session creation handled automatically.
- Easy commands for upload, export, track status, or credits; ideal for content creators and small businesses.
